Elena —

Thanks — answers below in-line as requested.

A) Data retention (one-paragraph summary): By default, Redwood does not persist customer prompt or response content beyond the active inference session unless configured by the customer. We offer configurable retention windows (default 30 days) for workloads that require short-term caching (e.g., KV cache to speed repeated requests). Customers can request immediate purge of cached content via the Console or API (DELETE /v1/retention) and such requests are recorded in audit logs; we provide confirmation once purges complete. Longer-term storage (for analytics or logging) is only enabled with explicit customer opt-in and is covered in the contract/SLA. See slide 6 of the attached security deck for retention controls and the audit log workflow.

B) KMS / key management (one-paragraph summary): Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) via integrations with common KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Google KMS). By default, we provision platform-managed keys; customers who require BYOK can provide key material or configure their KMS with our connectors. Access to keys is limited to the cryptographic service layer and only service principals with least-privilege roles can request key usage; human access to raw key material is restricted and auditable. We also publish key rotation and lifecycle practices in the attached ISO attestation; for customers requiring HSM-backed key control we offer a Private deployment option.

NDA path: Priyom will send our mutual NDA template to procurement today; once executed we will share the full SOC 2 report and pen test PDF. Priyom — please confirm when the NDA goes to Medisphere and who the authorized recipients are so we can stage secure delivery (S3 link + audit event).

Apologies for the rush — let us know if you need anything else for legal/procurement.
